'''Slan Street''' was a street in the [[Crimson Corridor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was reasonably well lit and one of the safer routes in the Crimson Corridor.<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>
